name: Ki no Tsurayuki
source:
Hobby: Dressing

He became a leading Waka poet by singing Waka that expresses women's minds. Rumor has it that people may even achieve happiness after listening to Tsurayuki's Waka.

[Edited from [url=https://akasekaeng.ppgame.com/miyabi.html]English official site[/url]]
